WITH smb_south AS (
  SELECT category, product, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(quantity) AS quantity
  FROM sales
  WHERE customer_segment = 'SMB' AND region = 'South'
  GROUP BY category, product
),
smb_south_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM smb_south
),
overall AS (
  SELECT category, product, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(quantity) AS quantity
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY category, product
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM overall
),
smb_south_agg AS (
  SELECT ss.category, ss.product, ss.revenue AS smb_south_revenue, ss.quantity AS smb_south_quantity,
         ROUND(ss.revenue * 100.0 / st.total_revenue, 2) AS smb_south_rev_share_pct,
         ROUND(ss.quantity * 100.0 / st.total_quantity, 2) AS smb_south_qty_share_pct
  FROM smb_south AS ss CROSS JOIN smb_south_total AS st
),
overall_agg AS (
  SELECT o.category, o.product, o.revenue AS overall_revenue, o.quantity AS overall_quantity,
         ROUND(o.revenue * 100.0 / ot.total_revenue, 2) AS overall_rev_share_pct,
         ROUND(o.quantity * 100.0 / ot.total_quantity, 2) AS overall_qty_share_pct
  FROM overall AS o CROSS JOIN overall_total AS ot
),
combined AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(s.category, o.category) AS category,
         COALESCE(s.product, o.product) AS product,
         COALESCE(s.smb_south_revenue, 0) AS smb_south_revenue,
         COALESCE(s.smb_south_quantity, 0) AS smb_south_quantity,
         COALESCE(s.smb_south_rev_share_pct, 0) AS smb_south_rev_share_pct,
         COALESCE(s.smb_south_qty_share_pct, 0) AS smb_south_qty_share_pct,
         COALESCE(o.overall_revenue, 0) AS overall_revenue,
         COALESCE(o.overall_quantity, 0) AS overall_quantity,
         COALESCE(o.overall_rev_share_pct, 0) AS overall_rev_share_pct,
         COALESCE(o.overall_qty_share_pct, 0) AS overall_qty_share_pct,
         ROUND(COALESCE(s.smb_south_rev_share_pct, 0) - COALESCE(o.overall_rev_share_pct, 0), 2) AS rev_share_diff_pct,
         ROUND(COALESCE(s.smb_south_qty_share_pct, 0) - COALESCE(o.overall_qty_share_pct, 0), 2) AS qty_share_diff_pct
  FROM smb_south_agg AS s
  LEFT JOIN overall_agg AS o ON s.category = o.category AND s.product = o.product
)
SELECT category, product, smb_south_revenue, smb_south_quantity,
       smb_south_rev_share_pct, overall_rev_share_pct, rev_share_diff_pct,
       smb_south_qty_share_pct, overall_qty_share_pct, qty_share_diff_pct
FROM combined
ORDER BY smb_south_revenue DESC

在澳大利亚内部按获客渠道分组，Referral渠道活跃率最低（60.0%），Organic渠道活跃率最高（91.67%）；各渠道订阅量在10-13之间，活跃订阅量在6-11之间。

  SELECT o.sales_channel, p.category, o.status,
         SUM(oi.line_revenue) AS actual_revenue,
         SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price) AS expected_revenue,
         (SUM(oi.line_revenue) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price)) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price), 0) AS revenue_deviation_ratio
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY o.sales_channel, p.category, o.status
),
target_combo AS (
  SELECT sales_channel, category, status
  FROM channel_category_status
  ORDER BY ABS(revenue_deviation_ratio - (-0.99)) ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
combo_refunds AS (
  SELECT o.sales_channel, p.category, o.status,
         SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS refund_count,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count,
         SUM(oi.line_revenue) AS combo_revenue
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
  WHERE (o.sales_channel, p.category, o.status) IN (SELECT sales_channel, category, status FROM target_combo)
  GROUP BY o.sales_channel, p.category, o.status
),
refund_reason_dist AS (
  SELECT o.sales_channel, p.category, o.status, r.reason,
         COUNT(*) AS reason_count,
         SUM(r.refund_amount) AS reason_refund_amount
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
  WHERE (o.sales_channel, p.category, o.status) IN (SELECT sales_channel, category, status FROM target_combo)
  GROUP BY o.sales_channel, p.category, o.status, r.reason
)
SELECT c.sales_channel, c.category, c.status,
       c.total_refund_amount, c.refund_count, c.order_count, c.combo_revenue,
       c.total_refund_amount / NULLIF(c.combo_revenue, 0) AS refund_rate,
       r.reason, r.reason_count, r.reason_refund_amount,
       r.reason_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.refund_count, 0) AS reason_share
FROM combo_refunds AS c
LEFT JOIN refund_reason_dist AS r
  ON r.sales_channel = c.sales_channel AND r.category = c.category AND r.status = c.status
ORDER BY r.reason_count DESC
